llm_response.reason: The site mimics legitimate brands (TikTok, Alibaba) through false claims of partnership and design, offers a suspiciously wide range of goods at unusually low prices, displays excessive sales numbers/reviews, and promotes urgency tactics and high affiliate commissions. It allows only cryptocurrency payments (unusual for real e-commerce), provides no verifiable business or contact information, and lacks navigable hyperlinks such as privacy or support pages. All these are major characteristics of online shopping scams.
